_about: LGIC_ENFORCE round-2 fixed input (issuer 2.0.0_SA_COO~G, L6): the RAISE population EN-r-2 classifies. Every nameable name of both census planes graded by lib/opal_naming.py grade() WITHOUT stopping. Each RAISE is grouped by the first quoted token of its message ('token:<t>'), or by its step when it quotes none ('step:<s>'); a group keeps its count, its steps and up to 3 examples (type, name, message). The union of both planes' group keys is the denominator. Written by the issuer's script at the cut, never by a worker.
